headline: Multimedia Artist
summary: Multimedia artist with three years making social media graphics and short videos for a regional food brand and its partners. I design posts in Canva, edit reels, plan content calendars and run the brand's pages and Facebook ads. I care about keeping everything we post on brand.

experience.title: Multimedia Artist
experience.paragraph: The company's only in-house creative, handling everything the brand posts online.
bullets: Design around 30 social media posts a month in Canva, following the brand's colours and fonts.
Shoot and edit short reels of recipes and product launches in CapCut and Premiere Pro.
Plan the monthly content calendar and run Facebook ad campaigns with the sales manager.
Keep the brand guide current and share templates with resellers.

experience.title: Social Media Assistant
bullets: Made event announcement graphics and posted photo albums after each event.
Replied to page messages and booking enquiries.

skill_groups.label: Video
items: video editing for reels (CapCut, Premiere Pro)

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, major in Multimedia
